title: TSFAlex SMP
description: TSFAlex SMP is a community-focused vanilla survival multiplayer Minecraft server created and run by TSFAlex. The server keeps the gameplay close to the original Minecraft experience, meaning there are no major gameplay-changing mods.
body:
**TSFAlex SMP** is a community-focused **vanilla survival** multiplayer Minecraft server created and run by TSFAlex. The server keeps the gameplay close to the original Minecraft experience, meaning there are no major gameplay-changing mods and players can enjoy the standard survival mechanics such as gathering resources, building bases, exploring the world, and cooperating or competing with other players.

The server encourages players to build, explore, and progress naturally while interacting with the community. Everything from large survival bases and farms to collaborative projects and adventures in the Nether and End are possible. While gameplay freedom is allowed, players are expected to stay respectful in chat and voice communication so that the environment remains friendly and enjoyable for everyone.

Players can join TSFAlex SMP by finding the server IP through the official website, which provides the connection details and information needed to start playing. The goal of the server is to create a relaxed survival world where players can have fun, be creative, and share a long-term Minecraft experience together.
